target_customer: Consumers who want to talk with AI characters; third party listings describe voice conversations with anime, game and romance characters
problem: Text chatbots feel flat. Directory listings describe Lifelike as letting users speak to AI characters by voice. The YC page gives no description.

founders.name: Alec Xiang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Instagram Equity at Facebook and infrastructure at Snorkel AI. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Inworld AI
competitors.what: Platform for AI driven characters with voice for games and the metaverse
competitors.funding_then: about $50M raised in August 2023 at a reported $500M valuation, after a $50M Series A in 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Low latency voice conversation with consistent character personas needed speech and LLM orchestration, available from third party APIs in 2023 but hard to make feel natural.

defensibility.rationale: Character chat apps were easy to clone and depended on third party models; no community or data advantage is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded character platforms existed before the batch; no source shows how they affected Lifelike.

market_need_then: No source about Lifelike's demand was found; the broader market for AI character chat was drawing large funding in 2023.

branding.domain_note: lifelike.app now redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page, so the domain is parked on 2026-11-17.
branding.community_and_virality: Directory listings say users could build and share characters; no independent evidence of community size.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic English word shared by many unrelated apps, with no press or community coverage found.

outcome_analysis: The cause of Lifelike's inactive status is not public. The company took YC pre-seed money in 2023 and built a consumer voice character product by directory accounts, but no shutdown post, acquisition or founder statement was found. The domain is now parked for sale, which is consistent with the company having stopped. No failure factors are assigned.
notes: The $500K pre-seed rests on VCBacked alone. A Dealroom listing for a different Lifelike (Hyperlight, with other founders) shows a $125K seed and closed status, plus an unverified $1.5M pre-seed claim; those belong to another company and are not recorded. Product descriptions come from third party directories and may refer to another app of the same name. The YC page has no description or launch post.
